tagline: Like Google Docs for coding agents

competitors.name: Claude Code
competitors.stronger_for: long-running refactors, migrations, and issue-to-PR workflows steered from terminal, IDE, or web
competitors.lightsprint_better_for: teams that want Claude or other agents inside one shared, visual, governed delivery session

competitors.name: Cursor
competitors.stronger_for: a developer who wants AI editing, completion, and agent work inside an IDE
competitors.lightsprint_better_for: product teams that need non-engineers and engineers to plan, steer, review, and ship together

competitors.name: Codex
competitors.stronger_for: teams standardized on OpenAI that want autonomous, parallel background agents and worktrees inside ChatGPT
competitors.lightsprint_better_for: teams that want Codex alongside other agents with shared context and live previews
